news.headline: Pump.fun lets callers time callouts with their buy
news.detail: Official @Pumpfun post (about 19:34 Berlin) says callers can now post a callout alongside their buy so the callout price matches the entry, instead of having to buy first and then write the idea (which made callouts look higher than the real buy). Post had about 10.4K impressions, 75 likes, 8 reposts, and 41 replies at scan time.

news.headline: Pump.fun deposits about $6.85M in SOL to Kraken after a 15-day pause
news.detail: X news story (updated ~16:36 Berlin) says Pump.fun sent 76,111 SOL (about $6.85 million) to Kraken after 15 quiet days, continuing a treasury pattern; cumulative sales cited at roughly 5.55 million SOL for about $882.4 million at an average near $158.88. Debate continues on selling pressure vs routine fee-treasury moves while SOL traded near $90.

news.headline: Valour lists PUMP, WIF, and BONK SEK ETPs on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market
news.detail: X post by @PetalSoI (3,713 followers) at 18:59 Berlin flagged Valour SEK exchange-traded products covering Pump.fun, Bonk, and dogwifhat on Spotlight Stock Market. Company release and Spotlight listings confirm eight new Valour digital-asset ETPs began trading 5 Nov 2026, including Valour Pump.fun (PUMP) SEK, Valour Dogwifhat (WIF) SEK, and Valour Bonk (BONK) SEK (1.9% management fee each), plus non-meme names such as Raydium and Morpho. Post engagement was still thin at scan (53 impressions, 0 likes).

news.headline: Pudgy Penguins PFPs fade as Abstract L2 shutdown pushes users toward real photos
news.detail: X news story (updated ~17:06 Berlin) says crypto users are swapping Pudgy Penguins profile pictures for real photos after Igloo Inc. announced Abstract, its Ethereum layer-2, will shut down on 15 Dec 2026 amid liquidity issues; the company is said to be refocusing on the Pudgy brand, NFTs, and the PENGU token, with mixed community reactions.

news.headline: Travladd says his memecoin launches in 10 days, runs $1,000 giveaway
news.detail: Futures trader @travladd (about 475,977 followers; OKX partner in bio) posted that his memecoin launches in 10 days, with a $1,000 giveaway plus $100 for someone who retweets. He claims no active bundle, plans to buy around 60% of supply and burn it, pay marketing in stables, and take profit from taxes rather than dumping tokens. Post had about 5,026 impressions, 203 likes, 199 reposts, 146 replies, and 15 bookmarks at scan time. No ticker or contract address yet.
